scope: Force-controlled commissioning hypothesis; not measured motor or gearbox capability

source_facts.friction_status: estimated environment input, unchanged from mobility01
source_facts.geometry_source: configs/robots/cad_base_mapping.json and robot_package_02 CAD mass inventory

derivation.assumptions: Quasistatic four fixed-axis wheels on a horizontal plane; equal commanded output torque; Coulomb lateral scrub. This is a sizing approximation, not an identified tire model.
derivation.equal_wheel_output_torque_formula: mu * mass_kg * gravity * wheelbase_m * tire_radius_m / (4 * track_m)
derivation.gain_selection: P=12 Nm/(rad/s) gives about 3.7 Nm at the original yaw reference and minimum mean wheel speed needed for the frozen 0.25-rad turn criterion; clamp4 provides a finite margin over the estimated 2.98-Nm scrub requirement.
derivation.hardware_caveat: No datasheet continuous torque, current, temperature or drivetrain efficiency has been verified; 4 Nm is a simulation hypothesis, not an assertion about installed actuators.
